segments.text: Think the Swift is just a looker? Think again - this car's got brains and brawn!
With a whopping 85 kW of power under the hood, this Swift is less 'swift' and more 'rocket ship'!
And when you add 160 N⋅m of torque to the mix, you'd better hold on tight - it's a wild ride!
The best part? All this power comes from a teeny 1.3-liter engine - who says size matters?

With an estimated price range of ₹5.79 lakh to ₹8.80 lakh, the ZXi variant is the real showstopper - 9-inch touchscreen, cruise control, 6 airbags, LED headlamps, and alloys, because you deserve it all!
Oh, and the cherry on top? The Swift sips fuel like a pro, delivering an incredible 26.4 km/L - your wallet and the planet will do the happy dance!
Swift or not-so-swift - which team are you on? Spill the beans in the comments, and hit that follow button for more automotive awesomeness!
